carjack.definition: v. take someone's car from him by force, usually with the intention of stealing it

carjacked.definition:

v. take someone's car from him by force, usually with the intention of stealing it

carjackers.translation: (carjacker 的复数) n. 武力劫夺汽车；抢劫司机财物 (carjacking的变形)

carjackings.definition:
plural of carjacking
